name: Beneath the Warden’s Cage

date.label: Burning Crusade quest chronology; exact in-world dating unknown

summary: At the Warden’s Cage, a submerged pool hides a chamber beyond the outpost. There the seeker finds Akama, no longer merely a name in another commander’s orders. At this meeting the question changes: the search has found the leader, but his place beside Illidan still conceals what he means to do.
